info.title: spio hosted control-plane API
info.summary: Versioned hosted workspace API for styio-view and repo-hosted control-console clients.
info.description: Design-first OpenAPI package for the hosted workspace API. The path family is frozen at `/api/styio-hosted/v1`; clients and backend services may vary base hostnames by deployment, but must preserve operation ids, request envelopes, response envelopes, and example payloads.

externalDocs.description: Normative governance note for this API package.
